                                   Paper official transcripts are prepared on stock paper. The seal of the University and signature of the office of the Registrar is used to validate each transcript.Transcripts that have been
                                   issued to the student are so noted. The transcript of a student's academic record is valid only if the University seal and the signature ofthe Office of the Registrar is affixed. No other agent
                                   of the University is authorized to issue an official transcript of a student's record. Official transcripts are alsosent electronically as PDF’s, from the email and office of the Registrar, who
                                   will re-validate any transcript for which the authenticity is questioned.
